card.name: Foreign articles and split words
card.fires_on: Small words like la, del, les or we in non-English text (Spanish, French, Dutch), or the start of a split word such as we|et, del|imita, la|ud. They often follow a preposition like sur, sobre or sous.

modes.label: Article after preposition
modes.description: Romance-language article la or les right after a preposition in titles or sentences.
modes.example: Charles Labitte has found it possible to write a book on "La Démocratie sous<< la>> Ligue".

modes.label: Split word piece
modes.description: A short piece that begins a longer word which is cut in two.
modes.example: Ik<< we>>et niet of ik dat met je eens

card.plain: It fires on little foreign-language words like la or les, often when a longer word has been split in two.
